lines.text: God tells Moses to bring Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar to serve as priests.
Two onyx stones engraved with the names of the sons of Israel are fastened on the ephod's shoulder pieces.
The breastpiece is square when folded double, with four rows of gemstones, and it is a span long and wide.
The robe of the ephod is entirely red cloth, with gold bells and pomegranates alternating around the lower hem.
Aaron wears a gold plate engraved THE LORD IS ONE on his forehead, fastened with a blue cord.
